question: Please calculate the growth rates for Asians, Black people, Latinx people, Native Americans, White people, US women, US men, global women, and global men from 2014 to 2024 concerning the overall workforce.
sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    workforce,
    report_year,
    race_asian,
    race_black,
    race_hispanic_latinx,
    race_native_american,
    race_white,
    gender_us_women,
    gender_us_men,
    gender_global_women,
    gender_global_men
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE workforce = 'overall'
),
v2014 AS (
  SELECT * FROM base WHERE report_year = 2014
),
v2022 AS (
  SELECT * FROM base WHERE report_year = 2022
)
SELECT 
  'Asian' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND(v2022.race_asian - v2014.race_asian, 4) AS growth_rate
FROM v2014, v2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Black' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND(v2022.race_black - v2014.race_black, 4) AS growth_rate
FROM v2014, v2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Latinx' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND(v2022.race_hispanic_latinx - v2014.race_hispanic_latinx, 4) AS growth_rate
FROM v2014, v2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Native American' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND(v2022.race_native_american - v2014.race_native_american, 4) AS growth_rate
FROM v2014, v2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'White' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND(v2022.race_white - v2014.race_white, 4) AS growth_rate
FROM v2014, v2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'US women' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND(v2022.gender_us_women - v2014.gender_us_women, 4) AS growth_rate
FROM v2014, v2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'US men' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND(v2022.gender_us_men - v2014.gender_us_men, 4) AS growth_rate
FROM v2014, v2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Global women' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND(v2022.gender_global_women - v2014.gender_global_women, 4) AS growth_rate
FROM v2014, v2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Global men' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND(v2022.gender_global_men - v2014.gender_global_men, 4) AS growth_rate
FROM v2014, v2022
